parameters.prompt: The exact upright bat warrior in the reference performs ONE ordinary bite in place. From the resting pose it crouches slightly and pulls the head back with the wings folded tight to the body, then lunges the upper body and head forward toward screen left and bites with the jaws snapping shut, holds for a brief moment, then pulls back and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. The wings stay folded close to the body the whole time. Exactly two arms, two wings and two legs. Keep the same three-quarter left view, bat head, ears, fur, wings and clothing. No walking, flying, spreading the wings, turning around, jumping, second attack, extra limbs, weapon. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, energy, coloured light, liquid, spray, projectile, feathers flying off, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shockwave, rings, shadow or text.
